{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id by keeping highest sample_seq
# First, confirm we have duplicates
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Duplicates: {len(df) - df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Deduplicate
df_clean = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df_clean["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Filter out those
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: divide biomarker_final by 10
print(f'Before correction: mean biomarker_final (batch A): {df_clean[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Before correction: mean biomarker_final (batch B): {df_clean[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')

# Apply correction
df_clean.loc[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final"] /= 10

print(f'After correction: mean biomarker_final (batch A): {df_clean[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "A"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')
print(f'After correction: mean biomarker_final (batch B): {df_clean[df_clean["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].mean():.2f}')

# Step 4: Compute improvement
# Improvement = final - baseline
df_clean["improvement"] = df_clean["biomarker_final"] - df_clean["biomarker_baseline"]

# Mean improvement across all patients
mean_improvement = df_clean["improvement"].mean()

print(f'Mean biomarker improvement: {mean_improvement:.2f}')

# Return the final clean dataset and mean improvement
mean_improvement"}
